'''Hitu''' is an [[Austronesian language|Austronesian]] language of the [[Central Malayo-Polynesian]] subgroup spoken on [[Ambon Island]] in eastern [[Indonesia]], part of a [[dialect chain]] of [[Seram Island]], by the [[Hitu people]].

{{lang|htu|Hitu}} is the name of a village; each of the villages, Wakal, Morela, Mamala, Hitu, and Hila, are said to have their own dialect.
